summary: Ueland disclosed 37 transactions, all dated July 15, 2026, split between 19 purchases (estimated $275K) and 18 sales (estimated $242K), for an estimated cumulative total of $517K. Every row was a mutual fund or ETF, and none of the 37 transactions were filed late. Nine rows fell in the filing’s larger reported range, $15,001 to $50,000; the other 28 were reported at $1,001 to $15,000. The most-traded assets were SCHO, VUG, VBR and VTV, each appearing three times.
